Select molecule_chembl_id, canonical_smiles
Join activities ON molecule_dictionary.molregno = activities.molregno
Join assays ON activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id
Join target_dictionary ON assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid
Join compound_structures ON molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno
Filter target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293232'
Filter assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'
Return molecule_chembl_id, canonical_smiles
Sort by molecule_chembl_id, canonical_smiles
